plain: Beings that he calls "the veterinarians" took him off his mountain bike and out of his bed, says John Blitch, a scientist who once worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency. He tells Michels they "pluck us out of our bed, play with us," using "the hurricane over my house" as cover to land. If true, it would mean these beings handle people much as a vet handles animals.
